positive: A user wants a surprise or procedural design direction without a manual interview
A product needs varied-but-tasteful design exploration across the valid option space
A creative exercise or design jam requires rapid, diverse system generation
negative: The user wants to commit to a specific direction by hand
A shipped public surface needs the full strict gate
The request is to improve an existing site rather than generate a new direction

exclusions: Do not roll outside the bounded answer space or bypass the design bounds
Do not present a chance-rolled design as a hand-interviewed committed direction
Do not skip the relaxed gate — random inputs still need contrast, readability, and self-containment checks

required: A numeric seed or instruction to derive one
optional: Chance MCP endpoint for multi-source entropy

outputs.primary: A seeded, reproducible DESIGN-SYSTEM.md with rolled answers and relaxed-gate evidence

stop_conditions: Stop when the rolled design will be a shipped public surface — escalate to tastecheck-pass strict gate
Stop if the user rejects the rolled direction and wants to answer the interview manually — hand off to design-system-interview
notes: Chance-design is the proof-of-thesis skill: constraints produce taste even from random inputs. It is explicitly a relaxed-gate entry point for personal artifacts and design exploration, not a replacement for the strict ship gate on public surfaces.
